title: Slightly increase sticky header branding logo size without layout issues

requirements.summary: Increase the header branding logo size across responsive breakpoints while keeping the sticky header layout aligned and overflow-free.
acceptanceCriteria: The logo image rendered in the header (frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx, ) appears noticeably but only slightly larger than before on mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.
The header layout remains vertically centered, and the logo does not overlap the brand name text or the desktop navigation/CTA.
No horizontal overflow is introduced at any viewport width (no unexpected x-scroll).
The logo remains crisp and maintains aspect ratio (no stretching).

file_operations.description: Adjust the Tailwind sizing classes to be slightly larger at mobile/tablet/desktop using safe arbitrary height values (keeping w-auto and object-contain for crisp aspect-ratio-safe rendering). Ensure surrounding header flex/layout classes continue to vertically center content and avoid any horizontal overflow or overlap with brand text/nav/CTA.
